summary_en: Tsukishima Holdings will acquire up to 1 million shares (2.5% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for up to 3 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between October 5, 2026 and March 19, 2027, to improve capital efficiency and shareholder returns ahead of a planned stock swap merger with Mitsubishi Kakoki.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On September 30, 2026, Tsukishima Holdings resolved to initiate a share repurchase program under Article 459 of the Companies Act and Article 38 of its articles of incorporation. The company will acquire up to 1,000,000 ordinary shares, representing 2.5% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum aggregate consideration of 3 billion yen. Purchases will be conducted through market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between October 5, 2026 and March 19, 2027, using a trading agreement arrangement.

The repurchase is intended to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder value as part of the company's capital allocation strategy, which balances growth investments with shareholder returns. The company stated this initiative aligns with its commitment to achieving capital cost-conscious management announced on May 12, 2026.

The acquired treasury shares are scheduled to be canceled entirely immediately before Mitsubishi Kakoki Co., Ltd. acquires all of Tsukishima Holdings' issued shares in a planned stock swap merger. The company notes that market conditions may result in partial or full non-execution of the repurchase program.
